offering_description.value: Provides global air and ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage and logistics services that move and clear goods for businesses importing and exporting across many countries. It arranges transport through a network of carriers and agents and handles customs and trade compliance paperwork.

primary_services.value: air freight forwarding; ocean freight forwarding; customs brokerage; contract logistics; trade compliance services

customer_segment.value: B2B: importers, exporters, manufacturers, retailers and distributors shipping goods internationally

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight forwarding and customs brokerage fees charged to shippers and consignees; project or contract: contract logistics such as warehousing and distribution for customers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: arranges transport and customs clearance for shippers, sold to importers and exporters; software / platform: proprietary shipment tracking and information systems used by customers

geography_served.value: global: offices and agents across Asia, Europe, the Americas and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: air freight, ocean freight, customs brokerage and contract logistics sharing the same customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff calling on shippers and importers; own locations: company-operated offices and warehouses worldwide; agents / brokers: overseas agent network providing origin and destination services
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customs brokerage and trade rules, export controls and transport security regulations from customs authorities and trade agencies
